sources.snippet: PromptRefine is a developer-focused AI application designed to help users understand and improve the quality of their prompts. Instead of sending an unstructured prompt directly to an AI model, the application analyzes the prompt, identifies missing information, evaluates prompt quality, and uses Gemini AI to generate an improved version.
